name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
description: BLS release schedules, metadata, documents, time series, and tables.

name: BLS Employment Situation
description: BLS Employment Situation — household (CPS) and establishment (CES) survey charts, release documents, and analytical tables.

name: BLS Consumer Price Index
description: BLS Consumer Price Index — release documents, news-release tables, reference tables, and the news-release chart package.

name: BLS Producer Price Index
description: BLS Producer Price Index — release documents, the detailed report, reference tables, and the final- and intermediate-demand chart packages.

name: BLS Productivity & Costs
description: BLS Productivity & Costs — release documents, supplemental tables, and selected charts.

name: Cboe Market Data
description: Delayed quotes, index levels, options chains, and the VIX futures term structure, published by the Chicago Board Options Exchange.

name: CFTC
description: CFTC COT reports, executed overnight index swap curves (par or zero), market-implied forward rate curves, FX forward points (executed vs covered-interest-parity, deliverable and non-deliverable), the FX implied-volatility surface, historical benchmark fixings, and raw swaps, forwards and options dissemination tapes.

name: Deribit
description: Order books, options chains, funding, and volatility indexes from Deribit's public market data API.

name: ECB Explorer
description: Start from the ECB statistical release calendar — click a release's dataset to explore its dimensions, series, and data — then dive into the presentation tables, euro exchange rates, key ECB and bank interest rates, the euro short-term rate, balance of payments, a full-content viewer for ECB releases and blog posts, and the Eurosystem list of eligible collateral assets.

name: U.S. Energy Information Administration
description: Official U.S. energy statistics from the Energy Information Administration: electricity, coal, total energy, the Short-Term and Annual Energy Outlooks, international energy, petroleum imports, natural gas, state energy profiles, and oil and natural gas maps, plus EIA's news and data-release feeds.

natural-gas-query.name: Natural Gas Annual Respondent Query System Browser

prompts: Summarize the latest Today in Energy articles.
What were the most recent EIA press releases about?
Show me U.S. electricity net generation by fuel in the electricity browser.
What are the latest retail gasoline and diesel prices from the fuel-price feed?

name: Fama-French Research Data
description: Explore the Kenneth R. French Data Library: research factors, research portfolios, country and international index portfolios, and the NYSE breakpoints used to construct them.

name: FOMC Documents
description: Read current and historical FOMC documents, beginning 1959.

name: Federal Reserve System - Stats & Indicators
description: Federal Reserve System data that is not specific to a regional district: the statistical release calendar, the Data Download Program releases and tables (click through to the underlying series), and key national indicators.

name: FFIEC & Bank Regulatory Data
description: Bank financials and regulatory data from the FFIEC, CDR, and the Federal Reserve. Call Reports, UBPR, Peer Group & By-State analysis, FR Y-9C, FR Y-15 systemic risk indicators, and FFIEC 009 country exposure.

name: Atlanta Fed
description: The Atlanta Fed's real-time growth and inflation toolkit: the GDPNow nowcast, Sticky-Price CPI, Business Inflation Expectations, the Wage Growth Tracker, the Survey of Business Uncertainty, the Market Probability Tracker, and Taylor Rule utilities.

name: Boston Fed
description: New England regional economics from the Boston Fed's New England Public Policy Center - employment, output, and prices across the six New England states, benchmarked against the nation.

name: Chicago Fed
description: The Chicago Fed's national and Seventh District barometers: the CFNAI national activity index, the NFCI financial conditions index, the Brave-Butters-Kelley and Midwest Economy indexes, advance retail trade (CARTS), labor-market conditions, and the AgLetter farmland-value and farm-credit survey.

name: Cleveland Fed
description: Inflation measurement from the Cleveland Fed - model-based Inflation Expectations, the Inflation Nowcast, and Median and trimmed-mean CPI with component detail, plus a systemic-risk indicator.

name: Dallas Fed
description: Texas and global activity from the Dallas Fed - the Texas Manufacturing, Service Sector, Retail, and Banking Outlook surveys, Trimmed Mean PCE, the Texas Leading and Weekly Economic indexes, the Energy Survey, and global growth and trade indicators.

name: Kansas City Fed
description: The Kansas City Fed's financial-stress and labor gauges plus agricultural finance - the KCFSI Financial Stress Index, the Risk-On/Risk-Off and Policy Rate Uncertainty indexes, model-based natural rates, the Labor Market Conditions Indicators, and the Agricultural Credit Survey and Finance Databook.

name: Minneapolis Fed
description: Ninth District labor-market and output data from the Minneapolis Fed - regional employment, unemployment, labor-force participation, quits, job openings, weekly claims, regional GDP and CPI, and the business conditions survey.

name: New York Fed
description: The New York Fed's reference rates and market plumbing - SOFR, the effective fed funds and overnight bank funding rates, SOMA holdings, and primary-dealer statistics - plus the Global Supply Chain Pressure Index, Multivariate Core Trend inflation, the Survey of Consumer Expectations, the Empire State manufacturing survey, and the Household Debt and Credit report.

name: Philadelphia Fed
description: Forecasting and business-cycle data from the Philadelphia Fed - the ADS Business Conditions Index, the Survey of Professional Forecasters, the Livingston Survey, the Anxious Index, GDPplus, the State Coincident Indexes, and the Manufacturing and Nonmanufacturing Business Outlook surveys.

name: Richmond Fed
description: Fifth District business surveys from the Richmond Fed - the Manufacturing, Service Sector, and combined State surveys and the CFO Survey - alongside the Non-Employment Index and a recession-probability indicator.

name: San Francisco Fed
description: Inflation decomposition and rate analytics from the San Francisco Fed - Cyclical/Acyclical and Supply/Demand-driven PCE inflation, the Proxy Funds Rate, the Treasury term premium and expected short-rate path, the Daily News Sentiment Index, and Fernald's Total Factor Productivity.

name: Saint Louis Fed
description: Macroeconomic data from the St. Louis Fed - the FRED-MD and FRED-QD large macro datasets, a national economic index, and the Economic Synopses research series.

name: FINRA
description: Security reference data, short interest, and OTC volume from the FINRA Market Data Center and Query API, with TRACE bond reference data, last sales, and end-of-day prices.

name: FRED
description: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) offers U.S. and global economic data, including GDP, inflation (CPI, PCE), unemployment, and consumer spending. It tracks interest rates, money supply (M1, M2), stock indices, bond yields, exchange rates, housing prices (Case-Shiller), mortgage rates, and trade balances. Industry data covers manufacturing, energy, and real estate.
authentication: Get your FRED API KEY at https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html

name: IMF Explorer
description: Explore economic indicators and presentation tables published by the IMF. Disclaimer: This application is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by the IMF. See https://data.imf.org/ for terms and conditions.

name: JODI Oil & Gas
description: Monthly world petroleum and natural gas supply, demand, and stock statistics, self-reported by over 100 countries through the Joint Organisations Data Initiative (JODI) World Databases.

name: Nasdaq Market Data
description: Company filings, market calendars, screeners, options chains and fundamentals, downloaded from the public Nasdaq website. This app is not affiliated with, or authorized by, Nasdaq.

name: OECD Data Explorer
description: Unofficial OECD Data Explorer (https://data-explorer.oecd.org/). Explore topics, indicators, time series, survey data, and presentation tables.

name: SEC Form 10-K/Q
description: Detailed SEC 10-K/10-Q analysis: Unstructured text, financial statements, and supplementary tables.
prompts: Summarize the key risk factors for the selected company.
What are the company's reportable business and geographic segments, and their revenues?
Summarize any material legal proceedings disclosed in the filing.

name: SEC Filings
description: Browse a company's SEC filings, use the EDGAR full-text search, view the latest submissions, get fund holdings, and read 13-F positions.

name: TMX
description: Canadian markets from TMX - equities, funds, indices, Montreal Exchange derivatives, and CIRO fixed income.

name: The United States Congress
description: Find and view US federal legislative information and complete bill text.

name: US Department of Agriculture
description: Agricultural production, export sales, prices, costs, land use, and trade from the USDA's Foreign Agricultural Service and Economic Research Service.

name: US Department of the Treasury
description: Federal debt, daily cash and debt operations, marketable securities auctions, the quarterly Treasury Bulletin, and federal contract and assistance awards, from the Bureau of the Fiscal Service, TreasuryDirect, and USAspending.gov.
